label: A nonuniversal CAUSE_2 of a thing's esse causes each of its actual perfections
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed: if c causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse) and c is not a cause of the esse of every other actual being (not CausesAllInGenus at esse), then for every respect r in which x is in act, c causes x's being in act in r. Exactly the first conjunct of STMT-RESIDUAL-PERFECTION-TRANSFER; it drops the residual's self-effect conjunct. Strictly weaker than the residual (Control.Controls part 2: a single being causing only its own esse satisfies it and falsifies the residual; the residual entails it, checked by the unregistered lemma nonuniversalOfResidual); given STMT-NOTHING-CAUSES-ITS-OWN-BEING it is equivalent to the residual (unregistered lemma residualIffNonuniversal). It is the part of the unrestricted transfer principle that neither universal-scope transfer nor the absence of self-causation of esse supplies. No source states it: the q.4 a.2 and q.6 a.2 support claims on the unrestricted principle concern God as first cause or as subsistent being, not particular causes. 'Cause' is CAUSE_2 at esse (CausesIn, effective causal responsibility for the effect's being, not mere coming to be).
